pregame.pressurePoint: BYU deep passing vs TCU secondary. TCU is No. 20 of 138 at limiting explosive passes (1.36). BYU ranks No. 125 in pass explosiveness (1.32). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Deep balls are the lowest-percentage play in this game. BYU needs the underneath game and yards after catch. Watch BYU's longest completion. If it is under 25 yards at the half, TCU has won the matchup.
